title: Osero's relationship with Sky rests on a bilateral Ecosystem Accord alongside the Primitive framework
content:
A.6.1.1.7.3.2 states that "Osero has formally agreed to the Ecosystem Accords herein," and A.6.1.1.7.3.2.1 identifies one: "Osero engaged in terms of agreement with Sky in Ecosystem Accord 6," located at A.2.8.2.6 - Ecosystem Accord 6: Sky And Osero.

The Accord is a different kind of instrument from everything else in the Artifact. Primitives are uniform mechanisms every Agent instantiates from a shared ecosystem-level specification; an Accord is named for its two parties and holds terms specific to them. It is bilateral where Primitives are universal.

Its placement is telling. The Accord appears under Omni Documents, not under Sky Primitives, because it is precisely the kind of relationship the Primitive taxonomy cannot express — the Primitives define what any Agent may do, while the Accord defines what Sky and Osero specifically agreed.

Two consequences follow. First, understanding an Agent's obligations requires reading outside its Artifact, since the Accord's substance lives in the Atlas at A.2.8.2.6 rather than being restated here. Second, the Artifact records assent rather than terms — its job is to establish that Osero is bound, not to reproduce what it is bound to.

The numbering (Accord 6) also implies a series of comparable bilateral agreements with other counterparties, so this is a standing instrument class in the ecosystem rather than a one-off arrangement for Osero.
description: A.6.1.1.7.3.2.1 records formal agreement to Ecosystem Accord 6, a negotiated instrument between Sky and one Agent that sits outside the uniform Primitive machinery.
